location_note: Coin report; no map reference. Placed by the name Har Homa (gazetteer, Z4).
notes: Eleven coins from the monastery at Har Homa (excavation: Zelinger, 'Atiqot 106, not in this reader's units). Hoard of three gold solidi deliberately hidden in a hole carved in the rock foundation of W520 in Room 509; latest coin Tiberius II (578-582 CE).

features.subtype: hoard of three gold solidi hidden in a hole in a wall's rock foundation ('the monastery's safe')
features.period: not before 578-582 CE (latest coin); concealment linked by the author to c. 610-614 CE
features.quote: A small hoard consisting of three Byzantine gold solidi was found
